title: Almost every K3 period is realised by a Koike-Uehara surface and carries infinitely many distinct homology classes of linear Levi-flat hypersurfaces
difficulty_reason: 扣去 Koike–Uehara 拼接定理、Howe–Moore、Torelli/Todorov、Siegel 迭代显式收敛半径与 coarea/Fubini 判据后，保留的是两步作者自写承重。其一是正测性：作者构造显式淹没 V:U→R^2（U⊂𝒟 开、𝒟∖U 零测），把参数族存在性升级为周期空间中非零测 Borélien 集，并用 Siegel 半径下界、缩小粘接半径抬高体积、coarea/Fubini 收束（Annexe 568–608、612–636）。其二是无穷性：把同调嵌入互异编码为 Γ-等变可测算子 H:𝒟→𝒫(ℰ)，再以作者完整写出的 Lie 群可测铺砌二分（prop 3.18，378–435，内层含 fait 3.19、lem 3.20、Mautner 现象 lem 3.21 与两个无标号 fait）排除 H 取有限值，得到几乎处处无限。L369 作者自述该二分亦可由 Bader–Gelander cor. 6.7 推出，故只扣除「对称空间铺砌二分」这一既有思想，不扣除论证本身。此处不是把'K3'、'周期域'或 Koike–Uehara 定理名当作难度来源。

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Similarité en dimension deux
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Read line by line. lem:NC-quotient quantifies over a family W of words whose cylinders I_a all satisfy M^{-1}\tau <= |I_a| <= M\tau and concludes a distribution-type bound #{a in W : |c_a/d_a - y| <= sigma} <= C \tau^{-\delta}\sigma^{\delta}, i.e. a non-concentration statement for the coding/limit-set coordinates of a Fuchsian group. JEP233 C1 states the existence of a nonzero Lebesgue-measurable Borel subset of the period domain D whose points are all periods realised by Koike-Uehara surfaces, plus infinite Hilbert-space embedding almost everywhere. JEP233 C2 states that for almost every period the attached Ahlfors class is dense in the hyperbolic boundary. Objects (word cylinders of a Fuchsian group vs periods of K3 surfaces and Hodge-theoretic Ahlfors classes), quantifiers (all comparable-size words vs almost every xi in D) and conclusions (a counting bound vs existence of a positive-measure family / density in the boundary) are all different: no implication either way. The only contact is shared vocabulary in the Fuchsian/Kleinian setting.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Quantum Mixing for Schr\"odinger eigenfunctions in Benjamini-Schramm limit
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Read line by line. LE:free_HS_est_exponential_mixing assumes a strictly hyperbolic Fuchsian group, a zero-average a in L^infty with an exponential-mixing correlation bound of rate kappa, and proves two Hilbert-Schmidt norm estimates for the time-integrated free (and modified free) wave propagators cut by the indicator of the far part X(>2T), with an explicit piecewise g_kappa(T). That is a spectral/dynamical estimate on one hyperbolic surface. JEP233 C1 is a measure-theoretic statement about periods realised by Koike-Uehara surfaces and infinite HLPL; JEP233 C2 is density of Ahlfors classes in the boundary of the compactified hyperbolic space associated to a period. Neither candidate assumes an exponential-mixing semigroup, proves any operator-norm estimate, or mentions wave propagators; no implication either way.

supporting_statement_comparison.label: lem:ahlfors-regularity
supporting_statement_comparison.statement:
303: \begin{lem}[Ahlfors regularity of the Patterson-Sullivan measure]
304: \label{lem:ahlfors-regularity}
305: There is a constant $C = C(\Gamma) >0$ such that for any interval $J$ of radius $r > 0$, we have
306: \[\mu(J) \leq Cr^\delta,\]
307: and moreover if $J$ is centered at a point in $\Lambda_\Gamma$, we have
308: \[\mu(J) \geq C^{-1}r^\delta,\]
309: as well as
310: \[C^{-1}\abs{I_\mathbf{a}}^\delta \leq \mu(I_\mathbf{a}) \leq C\abs{I_\mathbf{a}}^\delta.\]
311: \end{lem}
supporting_statement_comparison.owner_comparison: Patterson-Sullivan Ahlfors regularity (mu(J) <= C r^delta and the matching lower bound on intervals centred in the limit set) is a doubling/regularity property of one conformal measure. JEP233 C2 speaks of the Ahlfors class A(xi) of a K3 period: a set of period-domain points associated with the Koike-Uehara surface realising xi, asserted to be dense in the hyperbolic boundary. Judged on the statements themselves this is a shared word, not a shared claim; recorded here so the lexical overlap is on the record rather than silently dismissed.

current_unit_cross_comparison.reason: C2 uses C1 as an input (prop 3.16 supplies that A(xi) has at least two points, which the positive-measure tube argument needs), so the dependency runs one way only: C1 does not use prop 4.11 or the Ahlfors density machinery. Each has its own statement, its own proof and its own load-bearing context (Section 3 with the Annexe submersion argument vs Section 4 with lem-mes-conv and the convex-hull measurability). Counted as 2 units.

scope_and_claim_limits.observation: 作者固定 presque partout 的口径为周期域 $\mathscr{D}$ 上相对 Lebesgue 测度类，用 rem 环境写明测度类的良定义依赖 $\mathscr{D}$ 光滑。
作者固定 $B$ 与 $A:=\bigcup_{\gamma\in\Gamma}\gamma B$，并把 $\Gamma=\mathrm{O}(\Lambda,q)\cap\mathrm{SO}^\circ(q)$ 的格性归给 Borel–Harish-Chandra，不自行证明。
objets génériques 限定为 $\xi\in\mathscr{G}$（去掉所有 $\alpha^\perp$）；prop 3.15 的实现陈述只在此子集上成立。
作者明确指出 $(p,q)$ 的 diophantien 参数「on sait seulement qu'il est générique」，不下无条件结论。
Théorème 1.1 以两句组合 C1 与 C2 的结论，量化均为 presque tout 与 infinitely many，不声明对所有周期成立。

editorial_notes: Reuse the complete fixed work, index and PDF once; source author mathematics unchanged; no per-entry full native copies.
C1 quantifies over ξ in 𝒢 (all α^⊥ removed) and over diophantine (p,q); it does not claim the property for every period, and L222 states the missing modulus is only known generic.
C2's density is 'pour presque tout ξ' with r arbitrary; 𝒜(ξ) is only guaranteed non-empty on the full-measure set A, so no pointwise statement is available.

Zero/full measure is always relative to the Lebesgue measure class on the smooth period domain (rem 22, 293–295); the lattice property of Γ is cited from Borel–Harish-Chandra, not proved (notation 23, 298–300).
C1 and C2 are separate cores: C2 uses prop 3.16 as a deducted input, C1 uses nothing from Section 4. Statements and proofs of the two units occupy no common line.
